meaning:
1) to be intertwined
1a) (Pual) to be intertwined
1b) (Hithpael) to intertwine oneself

elsewhere.note: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
“The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me…
